lines: University of Sydney The David and Nhilla Dumbrell Scholarship 2021
Follow this page to get timely alerts on

The University of Sydney, Australia invites applications for the University of Sydney The David and Nhilla Dumbrell Scholarship 2021 from students studying piano. The aim of this scholarship is to support financially disadvantaged students at the Sydney Conservatorium of Music. Selected students will be able to get benefits as determined by the Dean of the Sydney Conservatorium of Music.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Have an unconditional offer of admission or being currently enrolled full time in a coursework or research degree at the Sydney Conservatorium of Music
Come from a financially disadvantaged background
The selected scholars will receive benefits as determined by the Dean of the Sydney Conservatorium of Music.
Follow the steps below to apply for the scholarship:
Selection will be based on academic merit, personal statement, demonstrated evidence of disadvantage and/or portfolio and/or performance.
All scholarship offers are conditional upon evidence that the student meets the selection criteria.
The annual payment will be made in two equal installments after the census date of each semester for coursework students.
For a postgraduate research student, the value of the scholarship will be paid as a stipend on a fortnightly basis.

Deferral of the scholarship is not permitted without the prior permission of the relevant Associate Dean and it is not transferable to another honours program, faculty/University school, or University.
The scholarship will be an offered subject as per the availability of funds.
To continue receipt of the scholarship, the recipient must maintain a minimum WAM of 65 each semester.
Recipients undertaking an exchange during the tenure of this scholarship are required to have achieved a Satisfied Requirements grade (SR) to receive their next payment.
Applicants may be required to attend an interview.
